newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: American Airlines to add Venezuela flight June 15.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines to add Venezuela flight June 15.

text.p: U.S. carrier American Airlines, a unit of Forth Worth AMR Corp, said it will add an extra daily round-trip Miami/Caracas flight on June 15 to the four it currently offers due to rising Venezuelan demand.

However, plans to begin flights to resort island Margarita and industrial city Valencia are still on hold, a company spokesperson said, as is a re-opening of the service to oil city Maracaibo in western Venezuela.
"We closed the Maracaibo flight down some ten months ago ... and there are no immediate plans to open it again," the spokesperson said.
American's main competitor on US/Venezuela routes is UAL Corp's Chicago-based unit United Airlines, although a new airline may start soon.

Representatives of bankrupt Venezuelan flag carrier Viasa said last week they were in talks with Pan Am Corp over a possible $50 million joint venture to restart the failed national airline under the new name "SkyVen".
